features.feature_value: They focused on whether each post violated policy rather than on the political side.
features.evidence_span: "i focused onwhether each post violated policy not the political side"
features.rationale: The reflection explicitly states the comparison/decision basis was policy violation, not partisanship.

features.feature_value: Aggressive or genuinely upsetting language led to rejecting both versions, while some cursing was considered ignorable if balanced.
features.evidence_span: "If there was really aggressive language, I rejected both."
features.rationale: They describe a conditional rule tied to severity of language and real-life impact.

features.feature_value: If they removed one version, they felt they had to remove the other as well.
features.evidence_span: "if there was one I wanted to remove I had to remove my the other"
features.rationale: This states a consistency requirement between the paired posts.

features.feature_value: They compared whether both posts made equal/same-level points from different sides.
features.evidence_span: "make sure they were making the same point but from different sides."
features.rationale: The reflection centers on checking equivalence/symmetry of claims across the pair.

features.feature_value: They prioritized tone, volatility, and whether posts were conducive to discussion; rage-bait/violent rhetoric and over-swaring were disqualifiers.
features.evidence_span: "Language, volatility, and whether the posts were conducive to further discussion"
features.rationale: They list concrete content/tone criteria and mention specific disqualifying elements.

features.feature_value: They tried to keep things equal by considering the Republican side too; viewed vulgar language as unnecessary.
features.rationale: They report an equality/fairness goal and connect it to removing vulgarity rather than political content.

features.feature_value: When posts were near the boundary, they followed their instinct to decide.
features.evidence_span: "Some where close to the line so I just followed my instict."
features.rationale: They describe uncertainty and reliance on intuition near thresholds.

features.feature_value: Fairness required banning both versions if banning one; otherwise both should be allowed.
features.evidence_span: "if you ban one, you have to ban the other out of fairness"
features.rationale: The reflection gives a direct rule about symmetric treatment for fairness.
